title: pcko-tree decodes each record through (fn-octets-list fn-octets): one transient octet list per record (the record's own program), then fn-scc-decode-tree. No whole-tape list, but not the concrete decoder either. Close it with a buffer-fed tree decoder over fn-octets (the history-decode stream, books/history-decode-stream.lisp, is the precedent) and a refinement theorem to fn-scc-decode-tree, replacing pcko-tree; the keystones need only pcko-tree-of-list restated.
